policy: Every requirement below is bound to a verbatim excerpt from the SIRI page named in source_roles. Nothing is paraphrased into an excerpt and nothing is inferred. No excerpt text was typed: each is resolved from LINE NUMBERS out of a numbered dump by scripts/visa-registry/excerpts-from-lines.mjs, which fails the file unless both the display and lowercase forms occur literally in the normalized text.
structure_note:
THE RIGHT TO WORK DEPENDS ON WHETHER THE PROGRAMME IS STATE-APPROVED, AND FOR ONE GROUP IT IS NOW ZERO. A student on a state-approved higher educational programme gets a limited work permit — 90 hours a month from September to May and full time in June, July and August. A student on a NON-state-approved programme who applied on or after 2 May 2025 gets no work permit at all and no right to work. Publishing the 90-hour figure as 'the student work rule' would tell that second group they may work, and working without the permit is what the authority calls illegal work, punishable by warning, fine or revocation.

THE SELF-SUPPORT FIGURE HAS A CAP THAT LOOKS LIKE AN ERROR IF YOU MULTIPLY. DKK 7,426 a month, multiplied by the months of study — but for studies over a year the total required is capped at DKK 89,112. Twelve months at 7,426 is 89,112, so the cap is one year's worth, and a three-year student does not need three times the sum. Someone applying the monthly figure literally would try to show DKK 267,336.
freshness_note: No dateline. Both money figures carry their own year in the text ('DKK 7,426 (2026 level)'), and the work-permit rule carries a commencement date of 2 May 2025, so revisions surface as text changes to the daily sync.

The step-by-step portal walkthrough and the document checklists.

requirements.label: You must be admitted to a higher educational programme and study full time
A residence permit cannot be granted for part-time study
You must understand the language of instruction well enough to participate actively
The educational institution must be publicly accredited
The programme must be approved by a state authority, or hold an advisory statement
Self-support: DKK 7,426 (2026 level) per month of study
For studies over a year the sum is capped at DKK 89,112 (2026 level)
requirements.description: The cap that stops the monthly figure being multiplied out across a whole degree.

requirements.label: A bank statement no more than 30 days old, showing date, name, balance and currency
Only liquid assets are accepted as documentation
A bank statement in someone else's name — a parent's, for instance — is not accepted
requirements.description: The most common way this requirement is failed.

requirements.label: A granted scholarship or student loan can satisfy the self-support requirement
Applicants under 18 need a declaration of consent signed by both parents
The school must declare it will ensure proper residence and study conditions
Processing fee
Normal processing time, and the longer time if information is missing
State-approved programmes: a limited work permit is granted alongside the residence permit
90 hours a month September to May, full time in June, July and August
Non-state-approved programmes: NO work permit and no right to work if applied on or after 2 May 2025
requirements.description: Quoted with the sentence that identifies which students it applies to, because the rule alone would read as applying to everyone.

requirements.label: Working more hours than allowed is illegal work — warning, fine, or revocation
Unpaid voluntary work of benefit to society is permitted without limit
A programme with a mandatory internship carries an automatic permit to work in it
You may not begin full-time internship work before the permit is granted
You must support yourself and may not apply for public benefits
Giving up your Danish address or staying abroad over 6 successive months lapses the permit
The permit lasts the nominal duration of the programme, if you actively participate
A permit can be extended by a maximum of 1 year
Apply no later than the day the permit expires, and no earlier than 4 months before
requirements.description: A window with a floor as well as a ceiling; applying too early fails too.

requirements.label: Changing educational programme requires a new residence permit
Completing a state-approved programme can bring a 6-month or 3-year job-seeking permit
